def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    marked_rows={r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1}
    marked_cols={c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1}
    for r in marked_rows:
        out[r]=[2]*w
    for c in marked_cols:
        for r in range(h): out[r][c]=2
    return out
